title: Long-read RNA Sequencing of Human Meningiomas
pipeline: bambu isoform quantification; GENCODE v47 annotation
needs_manual_review_reason: Series-level GEO metadata verified directly against the live source; per-sample clinical/pathology fields (grade, sex/age, anatomic location, brain invasion, treatment timepoint) have not yet been extracted from individual GSM records or supplementary tables -- part of the batch-1 scaling pass, prioritizing breadth of verified accessions over per-sample depth. Publication metadata pulled from PubMed esummary; not yet manually spot-checked against the full text for every record in this batch. EXTERNAL RE-VERIFICATION (2026-07-12): platform expanded from 'PacBio Iso-Seq (long-read)' to include the actual instrument from the linked GEO platform GPL34678 (PacBio Sequel IIe). reference_genome set to 'GRCh38.p14' and pipeline set to 'bambu isoform quantification; GENCODE v47 annotation', both read directly from the Series_supplementary_file name in the live GEO record (GSE300855_bambu_raleigh_isoseq.gencode_v47.GRCh38_p14.counts.for_GEO.csv.gz); previously 'Not reported'. GSM-level check: all 84 GSMs carry only 'tissue: meningioma' as a characteristic, so per-sample grade/sex/age/location remain genuinely unreported in GEO (described only in the paper, not deposited).
